import json
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode

class Hou_Mcp_Runtime_Analytics(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_runtime_analytics"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("report_type", "string", widget_type="text", default="full")
        self.add_input("window_sec", "float", widget_type="float", default=300.0)
        self.add_output("execution_metrics", "any")
        self.add_output("failure_metrics", "any")
        self.add_output("resource_metrics", "any")
        self.add_output("workflow_statistics", "any")
        self.add_output("trends", "any")
        self.add_output("report_json", "string")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        try:
            from src.runtime.runtime_analytics import get_runtime_analytics
            analytics = get_runtime_analytics()
            window_sec = float(inputs.get("window_sec") or 300.0)
            report = analytics.get_report()
            trends = analytics.get_execution_trends(window_sec=window_sec)
            return {
                "execution_metrics":   report["execution_metrics"],
                "failure_metrics":     report["failure_metrics"],
                "resource_metrics":    report["resource_metrics"],
                "workflow_statistics": report["workflow_statistics"],
                "trends":              trends,
                "report_json":         json.dumps(report),
                "exec_out": True,
            }
        except Exception as e:
            self.log_error(f"Runtime analytics error: {e}")
            return {"execution_metrics": {}, "failure_metrics": {}, "resource_metrics": {}, "workflow_statistics": {}, "trends": {}, "report_json": "{}", "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Runtime_Analytics
